signals.text: 2 open PM roles across 3 US offices

bullets: Own a product surface end-to-end, from strategy and prioritization through execution and continuous improvement.
Partner closely with engineering and design to build products that are intuitive, reliable, and scalable.
Use qualitative and quantitative data to identify opportunities, measure impact, and improve the customer experience.
Work across engineering, operations, finance, support, and go-to-market teams to solve complex customer and business problems.
Turn ambiguous problems into clear plans and help the team make thoughtful product decisions.

roles.title: Product Manager: Finfra
roles.location: Austin, Texas, United States; New York, New York, United States; Remote (US); San Francisco, California, United States

bullets: Own the strategy and roadmap for Thatch’s financial infrastructure, balancing reliability, unit economics, and new product opportunities.
Build and evolve our unified ledger, creating a trusted system of record for reconciliation, reporting, and treasury operations.
Make money movement more reliable and scalable, from premium payments and reimbursements to card transactions and banking integrations.
Improve the economics of how we hold and move funds, including treasury management, yield, and transaction costs.
Evaluate opportunities in card issuing, credit, and other financial products, making thoughtful decisions about what to build versus partner on.
